name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited
summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited (ASPHL), founded in 1987 and headquartered in New Delhi, owns and manages hotels across India under brands including THE PARK, THE PARK Collection and Zone by The Park. It also runs Flurys confectionery outlets and offers yachts for tourism. Its former name was Budget Hotels, changed in March 2004.
